label: late copy steps of length-9 sequences (token-modulated)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (99.8% of activation mass), essentially never on original inputs and almost never at <DEL>. Strongly tied to absolute position: active rate rises steeply with t (2.5% at t=12, 17% at t=16, 26% at t=17), concentrated in L=9 sequences (90% of mass) and late recall positions (recall_idx 7-8 hold ~70% of mass); nothing at L<=6. Within those late steps it fires only on a minority, modulated by token identity: inputs r, j, 2, z (and to a lesser degree g, u, i) and outputs k, v, 2, i raise the rate 2-5x, but token sets add precision only at a large recall cost, so the timing predicate is used. Mass recall ~0.75 but precision ~0.17: most late copy steps of length-9 sequences do not activate it.
